about_the_game:
Many Ducks is a whimsical 3D creature collector life sim adventure where you raise extraordinary ducks, explore a vibrant town, and prepare for the annual Duck Parade!

Welcome to Waddleton Cove!

You’re the new Duck Rancher in the charming town of Waddleton Cove, where ducks are more than just farm animals—they’re companions, performers, and sometimes… a little magical. As the new duck rancher, it’s your job to raise and train a diverse flock to compete in the town’s annual Duck Parade, a festival where only the most dazzling and well-trained ducks take center stage.

Key Features:

  • Play as a Cat – Because, of course, the best duck ranchers are cats.

  • Raise Unique Ducks – Catch, hatch, nurture, and evolve ducks with quirky traits and unexpected mutations.

  • Explore a Living Town – Befriend eccentric townsfolk, uncover local mysteries, and help shape Waddleton Cove’s future.

  • Dynamic Characters – Townsfolk have their own schedules, rivalries, and relationships, making every interaction meaningful.

  • Quests & Side Adventures – Take on odd jobs, solve duck-related mysteries, and perhaps uncover the lost legend of the Prismatic Duck.

  • Customize Your Ranch & Character – Customize your ranch, decorate your home, and create a unique look for your character.

  • Exciting Minigames - Take part in a plethora of minigames that make use of your ducks as key participants

Why Many Ducks?

Many Ducks is a heartwarming blend of farming, exploration, and adventure, wrapped in a humor-filled world that adapts to your choices. Whether you focus on raising champion ducks, forming bonds with the townsfolk, or simply enjoying the quirky charm of Waddleton Cove, there’s always something delightful to discover.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, any x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
